cases.setup: Publish A then B with the same snapshot_id.
cases.expected: Content identity stays equal; publication IDs/index_commit differ; staleness is independently evaluated.

cases.setup: Issue a cursor at current A; switch current to B; continue current.
cases.expected: cursor_snapshot_mismatch; no silent continuation in B.

cases.setup: Continue explicitly retained A while current is B with unchanged evidence/access and an unexpired token.
cases.expected: A is used throughout; no current reselection.

cases.setup: Replay example cursor in another authorized repository with equal content.
cases.expected: cursor_snapshot_mismatch.

cases.setup: Revoke principal after page one and increment authorization_revision.
cases.expected: access_denied before store/cache/cursor lookup.

cases.setup: Revoke principal after computation but before final authorization check.
cases.expected: access_denied; computed data is not delivered.

cases.setup: Refresh a still-authorized principal with different grants/revision.
cases.expected: Old signed cursor fails cursor_snapshot_mismatch; old cache entry cannot match.

cases.setup: Retain publication but change provider/evidence manifest or validated envelope.
cases.expected: Old cursor fails cursor_snapshot_mismatch; old cache entry cannot match.

cases.setup: Retain content/publication but change head-observation identity.
cases.expected: Old cursor fails cursor_snapshot_mismatch even if domain rows are unchanged.

cases.setup: Decode at now equal to expires_at.
cases.expected: invalid_cursor.

cases.setup: Decode at now less than issued_at.
cases.expected: invalid_cursor.

cases.setup: Decode with a removed or unknown signing kid.
cases.expected: invalid_cursor.

cases.setup: Verify an unexpired token using a retained verification-only key.
cases.expected: Valid until its original expiry; no lifetime extension.

cases.setup: Change normalized filter or page limit after page one.
cases.expected: cursor_snapshot_mismatch.

cases.setup: Modify signed payload bytes.
cases.expected: invalid_cursor; no payload hints.

cases.setup: Stage a corrupt diagnostic/object/location bundle then publish.
cases.expected: invalid_bundle; previous current remains exactly selected.

cases.setup: Two writers stage against generation 1; first commits generation 2.
cases.expected: Second returns selection_conflict; no implicit retry.

cases.setup: Replay identical publication and key after a later current selection.
cases.expected: Original receipt; newer current is not reset.

cases.setup: Reuse a key with different validated publication.
cases.expected: idempotency_conflict; no mutation.

cases.setup: Cache raises while valid pinned inputs are available.
cases.expected: Compute from the same pinned inputs, with final authorization check.

cases.setup: Populate a valid cache entry, revoke access, then repeat.
cases.expected: access_denied before cache read.

cases.setup: Reset and rebuild projections for one repository.
cases.expected: Users/sessions/authored source and other repositories are preserved.

cases.setup: Read C12 history for DOC-1 and DOC-2 in one generation.
cases.expected: Same generation; independent validated document-scoped envelope digests.

cases.setup: Submit provider, evidence root, signer or access_context as public fields.
cases.expected: invalid_request; no invocation of caller-selected providers.

cases.setup: Resolve two different requested_ids in the same document with identical publication/history context and a populated PageCache.
cases.expected: Neither C12 invocation calls PageCache.get/put; each result preserves its own requested_id and resolution.

cases.setup: Insert C11 data at now=1000 with access.expires_at=1200 and fresh_until=1100; read at 1099 and 1100.
cases.expected: expires_at=1100; reuse is eligible at 1099 after context/access checks and rejected at 1100 even if the backend returns the stale entry.

cases.setup: Attempt C11 cache insertion with fresh_until=0, then with a deadline equal to now.
cases.expected: Neither inserts an entry; query execution retains inherited staleness/evidence behavior.

cases.setup: Populate C11 PageCache, then test a retired publication and, separately, a new invocation pinned to a valid unavailable-provider identity.
cases.expected: A retired publication returns the existing selection/store error before lookup. Valid unavailable-provider identity preserves inherited partial/unknown/error semantics without reusing the old evidence entry or repinning mid-request.
